 W.P.(C).

Nos. 2228 of 2025 & 2285 of 2025
 ---------------------------------
 Dated this the 4th day of March, 2025
 Judgment

The petitioners in both these writ petitions are brothers and the main prayer is for granting the benefits under Section 94(3) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by acquiring the entire extent of land instead of a portion of the land.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The petitioners have preferred Ext.P12 representation in both these cases before the 1 st respondent and seek an early disposal of the same.

In view of the limited prayer made, these writ petitions are disposed of directing the 1st respondent to consider and pass orders on Ext.P12 representations filed in both these cases, after hearing the K.P.Shaju vs State Of Kerala Rep. By Principal ... on 4 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/119972828/
3 petitioners, at the earliest, at any rate, within three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this judgment.
The petitioners may produce copy of the writ WP(C) NO.2228 & 2285 OF 2025 2025:KER:18733 petitions along with a copy of this judgment before the 1 st respondent for necessary compliance.
